# Kotz Heating, Cooling & Plumbing

> > Full-service HVAC and plumbing company serving Oakland County, Michigan with heating, cooling, water treatment, and plumbing solutions.

Kotz Heating, Cooling & Plumbing provides residential and commercial HVAC services, plumbing repairs, water quality testing, and water treatment systems throughout Oakland County communities including Auburn Hills, Birmingham, Bloomfield Hills, Clarkston, Farmington, and Waterford.
